subject: Proposition 2 1/2 Ballot Questions
overview: Community organization All Medford hosted an informational session discussing the upcoming municipal ballot questions on Proposition 2 1/2 overrides and a debt exclusion. Former Superintendent Roy Belson presented an analysis of city finances, school spending, and tax impacts, arguing against the operating overrides.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Introduction
items.summary: George Scarpelli introduced the forum regarding the upcoming ballot questions for school and public works overrides and a fire headquarters debt exclusion, welcoming former superintendent Roy Belson.

items.title: Presentation on Proposition 2 1/2 Ballot Questions
items.summary: Roy Belson evaluated the city's financial standing, per-pupil expenditures, and reserves, arguing that Medford possesses sufficient free cash and competitive metrics to avoid an operational tax override.
